THIS CRL.P FILED U/S.439 CR.P.C PRAYING TO ENLARGE THE  PETITIONER ON BAIL IN CR.NO.290/2023 OF YESHWANTHAPURA  -2-  NC: 2023:KHC:41402  CRL.P No. 10328 of 2023 P.S., BENGALURU CITY

FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S. 376(2)(n), 506,
34, 323 OF IPC U/S.SEC.3, 4, 5(L), 6 OF POCSO ACT AGAINST THE PETITIONER WHICH IS PENDING ON THE FILE OF THE COURT OF THE ADDL.CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE FTSC-II BENGALURU.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER 1.

Accused in Crime No.290/2023 registered by Yeshwanthapura Police Station, Bengaluru City, for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 506, 34, 323 IPC and Sections 3, 4, 5(L), 6 of the POCSO Act, 2012, is before this Court under Section 439 Cr.PC.
2.
Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.

3. Complainant who is the victim in the present case had filed a typed complaint dated 31.08.2023 before the Station House Officer of Yeshwanthapur Police Station, Bengaluru, and based on the same, FIR in Crime No.290/2023 was registered by Yeshwanthapura Police Station against the petitioner and others for the aforesaid offences.
4.
During the course of investigation of the case, the petitioner was arrested on 01.09.2023.

His bail application filed before the Court of Addl. City Civil & Sessions Judge, FTSC-II, NC:
2023:KHC:41402 Bengaluru, in Crl. Misc. No.8963/2023 was rejected on 25.09.2023.

entities.text:
Court of Addl. City Civil & Sessions Judge, FTSC-II, NC:
2023:KHC:41402 Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Therefore, he is before this Court.
5. Learned Counsel for the petitioner having reiterated the grounds urged in the petition submits that the petitioner was granted interim bail by this Court on 13.10.2023.
He has complied with the bail conditions and accordingly, prays to confirm the interim bail granted to the petitioner.
6. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition.

sentences.text: 7. Learned Counsel appearing for respondent no.2/defacto complainant submits that she has no objection for granting bail to the petitioner.
She also submits that the defacto complainant who is a major has now married the petitioner.

8. This Court on 13.10.2023, considering the affidavit filed by the defacto complainant wherein she has stated that she was in living in relationship with the petitioner and she had physical relationship with him by consent and as a result she got pregnant and thereafter they have decided to get married, had granted interim bail to the petitioner subject to certain conditions.
NC: 2023:KHC:41402 9.

The submission made by the learned Counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner has not violated any of the bail conditions and inturn he has complied with all the bail conditions is not seriously disputed by the learned HCGP.

10. Learned Counsel for the defacto complainant in the presence of the defacto complainant who is a major, has made a statement before the Court that the petitioner and the defacto complainant are now married and she has also stated that she has no objection to confirm the order of interim bail granted by this Court.
11.
Under the circumstances, without adverting to the merits of the case if the interim bail granted to the petitioner is confirmed, the same would serve the ends of justice.

Accordingly, the following order:
12. Criminal petition is allowed.

Sd/-
